invariants.rule: A runtime-required Full task must read the complete raw ledger before acceptance-ID/status filtering, replay append order, and open persistent correction debt for every identity-unreadable append and every readable current-baseline append whose status or required evidence is invalid. Only the newest later complete row whose corrects_append_position names that exact debt and preserves every parseable target identity/baseline component may close it; normal, cross-ID, stale-relabel, or invalid evidence cannot. After all debts close, the task selects each required acceptance_id's newest effective current-baseline append by position before validation and never falls back.
invariants.positive_case: An unfiltered full-ledger read retains unreadable and readable-invalid appends as debts; each newest exact-pointer correction is complete and matches all parseable target identity/baseline components; after all debts close, every required acceptance_id's exact newest effective current-baseline append validates as runtime_acceptance_pass.
invariants.negative_case: An older ACC-A pass is followed by an unreadable/raw or readable-invalid current append and then a normal pass, wrong pointer, invalid newest correction, ACC-B correction, or stale/different-baseline correction; filtering or relabeling clears debt and exposes the old pass instead of remaining blocked.
test_evidence: cross-ID and baseline-relabel correction rejection scenario

invariants.rule: A local layer check must not replace a falsifiable source-to-sink Integration or target-runtime outcome.
invariants.positive_case: The known-bad detail.userRole DTO fixture fails along the full API-to-UI path.
invariants.negative_case: A helper unit test passes while the controller remains loading.

invariants.rule: ClosureSpec alone produces one exact AcceptanceResolution containing baseline_binding, ledger_snapshot_ref, reconciliation_snapshot_ref, both open blocker sets, rows, refs, task result, blocking IDs, and next_probe from complete unfiltered ledger/register snapshots. Any append, register update, or baseline change requires full recomputation.
invariants.positive_case: The result binds exact ledger/register snapshot refs and complete fields; an append or register transition forces a new result.
invariants.negative_case: A consumer reuses an older result or projects away reconciliation so an unacknowledged retrospective/later pass bypasses the blocker.

invariants.rule: ClosureSpec TaskRef-locates the exact journal and acknowledges prepared before append. Append ref alone stays open. Repair builds record/ref; acknowledged record-bound includes both refs and exact closes_attempt_ids (ordinal-0 or 0+1), binding every chain entry. Missing/extra/cross-chain IDs or missing/corrupt journal blocks; one retry maximum.
invariants.positive_case: Prepared is acknowledged before append; accepted or unique suffix match yields append ref, Repair builds record/ref, and acknowledged record-bound with both refs closes before fresh resolution.
invariants.negative_case: After accepted pending row, journal rolls to older valid prefix/empty, reuses a repeated-row chain or cross-position ref, then later pass; Finish must block/null probe.
test_evidence: fresh-session exact-path discovery and missing/corrupt journal scenario
